units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:4:4">Y. Ned. IX, end, 41ᶜ</cite> <he>נפקת ק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>סים …</he>) an order was issued by the king &c.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>כבר הוצאתי קלווני׳ עליו וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) I have once issued a decree concerning him that they should ‘lift up’ his head &c.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Ib.</cite> <he>יכולה קילוילוסיו שלך קיימת וכ׳</he> (read: <cite ref="S00958"><he>קילווסין</he></cite>) thy decree may stand, and yet thy son may remain in his place (rank) uninjured.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ונמצא ק׳ שלך קיימת וכ׳</he> (not <he>סים …</he>) and thus thy decree will be upheld, and high rank will be thy son’s.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:3">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> <he>נלך ונעשה ק׳ של הקב״ה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קילוסין להקב״ה</he>, corr. acc.) let us go and carry out the Lord’s command.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:5">Lam. R. to V, 5</cite> <he>אדריינוס</he> … <he>אפיק ק׳</he> Ar. (v. Matt. K. a. l.; differ. in ed.) Hadrian … issued a decree.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 5:5">Ib.</cite> to I, 5 <he>בגין דעברת על קלוונין דידי</he> (corr. acc.) whereas thou hast disobeyed my order.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> <he>אנא יהיב קילוון וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) I give out an order &c.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 7:6">Lev. R. s. 7</cite> <he>נימוס וקלוסים הוא וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.; some ed. <he>נ׳ ק׳</he> corr. acc.; Ar. <he>נ׳ הוא וקילוסין הוא</he>) it is a custom and a decree that he &c.—[Lam. R. introd. (R.
